Function words (articles, prepositions, pronouns, conjunctions, small adverbs) for A1 to B1 learners, with Spanish meanings, examples and the traps Spanish speakers fall into. German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Arabic and Irish.

Translation runs on your phone with Google ML Kit: free, no account, no API key. Each language pack (about 30 MB) downloads once from Google; after that it works without internet and your text never leaves the phone.
